LlamaCraftThe Official Minecraft Server

A fun survival server with custom enchants, proximity voice chat, land protection, and cross-play for everyone.

Custom Enchants

Put cool magic on your gear like extra hearts, 3x3 mining, lightning strikes, and fire shields.

Talk In-Game (Voice Chat)

Hear players get louder as they walk closer to you, just like real life. Works on PC, phones, and consoles.

Play on Any Device

Java players, Bedrock players on phones, tablets, PCs, and consoles can all play together in the same world.

Protect Your Base

Claim your land with a golden shovel so nobody can grief your blocks, open your chests, or steal your loot.

Fishing & Magic Books

Catch rare fish and unlock secret enchantment books just by fishing with friends.

Easy Commands

Simple commands to teleport to friends, set your home, open shops, and join fun arena battles.
